name: George
source:
Hi, Master! I'm Brown Bess... well, my other personality, George.
Brown Bess is the first musket to be officially adopted by the British Army, but during the American Revolutionary War, she wasn't used just by the British—she was also used by American militiamen.
That's a complicated thing for Brown Bess herself, but... long story short, that's how I came to be.
I'm one of the older antique guns out there, and I might not be much use on the battlefield at all, but I'll do my best to protect you, Master. Looking forward to working with you!
